interfaces.name: coordinates
interfaces.constraints: Nonempty finite real vector, at most 64-bit elements, aligned row-for-row with values. No sorting or centering. Caller establishes coordinate units and observation availability. Converted through an uncentered float64 [coordinate,1] design; large integers may lose precision.

interfaces.name: values
interfaces.constraints: Finite real vector with exactly the coordinate shape, at most 64-bit elements. Caller establishes value units and row alignment. No weighting, imputation or availability inference.

interfaces.name: rcond
interfaces.constraints: Required explicit None, -1 or finite ratio in [0,1); booleans rejected. None uses installed NumPy size-dependent cutoff, -1 machine precision, otherwise relative singular-value threshold. Changes rank and minimum-norm coefficients; not regularization.

interfaces.name: result
interfaces.constraints: Dictionary with float64 coefficients of shape (2,) ordered slope/intercept, integer rank, float64 singular_values of shape (min(N,2),), and float64 residual_sums_of_squares shape (1,) only when N>2 and rank=2, otherwise (0,). Empty residuals do not imply zero error. Rank below two means coefficients are not uniquely identifiable; the minimum-norm solution is retained. Slope units are value/coordinate; intercept uses value units. Inputs unchanged. Runtime LAPACK dependent. Concrete provisioned execution only; abstract witness intentionally rejects.

providers.operation: Fit uncentered affine least squares with explicit singular-value rank cutoff and minimum-norm diagnostics.
providers.plain_description: Fit a straight line to paired numbers and report whether its slope and starting value can be determined uniquely.

limitations: Automated Tier 3 for concrete provisioned in-process execution only; no human Tier 1 or empirical Tier 2 claim.
Caller establishes units, alignment and observation availability. No centering, weighting, regularization or temporal filtering.
Rank below two returns minimum-norm coefficients, not uniquely identified slope/intercept. Empty residual arrays do not imply zero error.
Explicit cutoff is runtime dependent: None uses the installed NumPy size-dependent default; -1 uses machine precision.
Float64 design conversion can lose large-integer precision. Abstract witness intentionally rejects; no static dimension inference is qualified.
Synthetic motion and sensor examples establish numerical reuse only; the original OSIC workflow is not approved by this review.
Installed RECORD hashes and active requirements are checked; independent distribution provenance and other platforms remain outside qualification.
